description:
What Impact You'll Have 

 GRVTY is seeking Software Engineers for multiple openings supporting mission-focused applications, data platforms, and software solutions. Opportunities span Java/backend development, Python and AI integration, and Kubernetes-focused software engineering.  You will collaborate with engineers and customer stakeholders to develop reliable, secure, and maintainable software. Your responsibilities will align with your experience, technical specialty, and the needs of the specific opening.

 What You'll be Owning 

 Depending on your assignment, you will:

 
 Design, develop, test, maintain, and troubleshoot software applications, services, and reusable components.

 Build and integrate enterprise APIs, RESTful web services, and microservices.

 Develop Python-based services and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications.

 Develop and maintain containerized applications and Kubernetes deployments.

 Participate in code reviews, automated testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

 Use development tools and, where applicable, AI coding assistants to support implementation, refactoring, and testing while reviewing generated code for security, performance, and quality.

 Collaborate within an Agile team to translate requirements into working software.

 For senior openings, provide technical guidance, mentor engineers, and contribute to architectural decisions.

 
 Positions may require work at a customer site, office, or a combination of onsite and remote work. Hybrid availability and onsite frequency depend on the specific opening and may change with customer requirements.

 What You Must Have 

 
 An active U.S. Government Secret clearance or higher and U.S. citizenship. Certain openings require an active Top Secret clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI. Candidates must meet the clearance requirements of the specific assignment.

 Relevant software engineering experience and education appropriate to the opening: 

 All openings require at least 5 years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree in a related field; 3 years with a related master’s degree; or 9 years with a high-school diploma or equivalent.

 Senior openings require at least 9 years of relevant experience with a related bachelor’s degree; 7 years with a related master’s degree; or 13 years with a high-school diploma or equivalent.

 Experience developing, testing, maintaining, or troubleshooting software in a relevant technical specialty.

 Experience designing enterprise APIs, RESTful web services, and microservices.

 Familiarity with Git or comparable version-control tools and comfort working in a Linux environment.

 Strong problem-solving skills, attention to software quality, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

 Ability to meet the location and onsite requirements of the assigned opening.

 For designated openings, an applicable DoD 8140/8570 certification, such as Security+, or the ability to obtain the required certification within the specified timeframe, which may be within 60 days of hire.

 Candidates are considered for openings that match their skills; experience in every specialty below is not required. 

 
 
 
 Java and backend development: Strong Java development skills; experience with frameworks or libraries such as Spring or Guava; object-oriented programming; enterprise APIs, RESTful web services, and microservices; and tools such as Git, Maven, and Nexus.

 Python and AI integration: Strong Python backend development experience; hands-on integration of commercial large language model APIs or open-source models into applications; understanding of agents, prompting, tool use, and retrieval-augmented generation; and experience deploying containerized workloads in Kubernetes. Assignments may include developing Model Context Protocol servers, reusable AI tools, and safeguards for enterprise AI use.

 Kubernetes-focused software engineering: Strong Java development experience and hands-on experience building and maintaining Kubernetes deployments using tools such as Helm and Flux.

 Senior technical responsibilities: Demonstrated experience serving as a technical lead, mentor, or engineering manager where required by the opening.

 
 
 What Would be Nice to Have 

 
 Experience with AWS or Azure.

 Experience with data lakes, data warehouses, Big Data Platform environments, or distributed systems.

 Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or search technologies such as Elasticsearch and Solr.

 Experience with CI/CD automation, GitLab pipelines, scripting, or additional languages such as Go and Python.

 Experience developing Kubernetes operators, custom resource definitions, or other custom Kubernetes tooling.

 Familiarity with AI integration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen; vector databases; semantic caching; and AI observability.

 Experience with Kafka, NiFi, or integration of Java services with Python-based AI capabilities.

 Experience using AI coding assistants for implementation, refactoring, and automated testing.

 Familiarity with Agile development tools such as Jira and GitHub.

 Why Choose GRVTY 

 
 The toughest national security challenges demand vision and ingenuity, not just resources. We deliver mission and technical expertise to outpace our adversaries. We’re purpose-built to tackle the most entrenched, systemic national security issues around the world.

 We partner with our customers to help them overcome challenges in every corner of technology and defense—including the ones still being explored. Our growing capabilities create complementary advantages, giving on-the-ground operations the edge they need to succeed. We muster everything we have to answer every challenge presented, every day of our lives.

 At GRVTY, we believe that when our employees thrive, our company thrives. That’s why we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

 •    Robust health plan including medical, dental, and vision  

 •    Health Savings Account with company contribution  

 •    Annual Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays  

 •    Paid Parental Leave   

 •    401k with generous company match  

 •    Training and Development Opportunities  

 •    Award Programs  

 •    Variety of Company Sponsored Events

  

 EEO Statement 

 
 GRVTY, is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. 

 Anyone requiring reasonable accommodations should email  recruiting@grvty.com  or call 703-544-7930 with requested details.  A member of the HR team will respond to your request within 2 business days. 

 Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal (eeoc.gov)   

 Please review our current job openings and apply for the positions you believe may be a fit. If you are not an immediate fit, we will also keep your resume in our database for future opportunities.
